# Maramao

> Maramao is a free, open-source Pomodoro timer for the macOS menu bar. You work for 25 minutes, then a cat takes over the screen so you actually take the break. Native Swift app (SwiftUI and AppKit), macOS 13 Ventura or later, Apple Silicon and Intel, MIT license, no special permissions, no tracking. The app's interface is in Italian, with an English translation when macOS runs in English.

Key facts:

- Lives in the menu bar only (no Dock icon). Work, short break, long break and the number of pomodori before a long break are configurable.
- Break modes, each a different cat: "Il gatto sulla finestra" (a cat sits on the window you are working in and follows it), "Muro di meme" (the screen fills with cat memes), "Non svegliare il gatto" (a sleeping cat that wakes up and judges you if you touch the mouse), "Invasione di gatti" (cats rain down and bury the screen), "Caccia al laser" (the mouse becomes a laser dot a cat chases), "Il gatto sulla tastiera" (a cat sleeps on the keyboard and turns typing into cat-typing), and "Sorpresa" (a random one each break).
- Breaks can be skipped after a minute, or never in strict mode ("modalità severa"). "Rimanda" snoozes a break for 1, 3 or 5 minutes, a few times a day.
- Breaks wait while the microphone or camera is in use, or a presentation or call app is fullscreen.
- Every cat is drawn in code. Users can add their own cats with "cat packs" (folders with a pack.json, CC0 or CC-BY art).
- Automation: `maramao://start`, `maramao://pause`, `maramao://break`, `maramao://skip`, `maramao://mode/<id>` and more; Shortcuts actions; global shortcuts such as Control-Option-Command-P to start or pause.
- Emergency exit from any break: Control-Option-Command-Delete, or five quick clicks in the top-left corner of a screen.

## Install

- Download the DMG from https://github.com/kkratterf/maramao/releases/latest and drag Maramao to Applications.
- Or one line in Terminal: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkratterf/maramao/main/install.sh | sh`
- Or Homebrew: `brew tap kkratterf/maramao https://github.com/kkratterf/maramao && brew install --cask maramao`
- The app is not notarized by Apple yet. If macOS blocks the first launch, open System Settings > Privacy & Security and click "Open Anyway" next to the Maramao message, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Maramao.app`. The install script does this for you.
- Uninstall: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkratterf/maramao/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --uninstall`, or `brew uninstall --zap --cask maramao`.
